about: Decisions and issued warnings: who (by), what, when (at, at_epoch in seconds when known to the minute), status, and what each followed. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs from the incident's JSON; every row carries label, source, read and origin. Not a warning service.

rows.decision: "Nombrada la borrasca Charles": a storm of subtropical origin, very adverse rain, wind and sea on Wednesday and, less, Thursday; a special warning to follow
rows.label: fact
rows.note: AEMET's own Bluesky account; createdAt 2026-11-09T10:20:11.685Z (read through the public API). 2 h 57 min before 13:17, the time we hold for IPMA's communiqué no. 1.

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Names the low CHARLES (communiqué no. 1); orange warnings to follow, upgrade not ruled out
rows.label: fact
rows.note: 02:42Z: not verifiable at source: IPMA's communiqués page and RSS now carry only no. 2 (valid from 17:07 on 10 Nov), so no. 1's own publish time cannot be read; 13:17 is weather@'s reading of the page on 10 Nov. AEMET posted "Nombrada la borrasca Charles" on Bluesky at 2026-11-09T10:20:11Z (aemet-names-charles). IPMA's communiqué no. 2 says "CHARLES é o nome atribuído pelo Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera". Whether IPMA's naming was public before 13:17 is not established.

rows.by_name: Capitania do Porto de Lisboa (harbour master, Autoridade Marítima Nacional)
rows.decision: Aviso n.º 53/2026, "Agravamento de condições meteorológicas, 09 a 11 de novembro de 2026": relays IPMA's then yellow sea and wind warnings for the Lisbon and Setúbal regions and asks the maritime community and shoreline users to take precautions
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Signed 2026-11-09T14:07:38Z (PDF signature; created 14:05:49). PDF sha256 ce7849c00de2087c… (first 16 hex). It predates the red and orange warnings of 10 Nov; no later notice (no. 54 or after) found yet. A lead from leads.json.

rows.decision: Public warning Aviso 21: gusts to 120 km/h, avoid unnecessary travel

rows.note: 11:56Z: superseded by carris-service-1156 (Carris's own page).

rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Said by the mayor, not read on metrolisboa.pt (no notice found in its HTML at 18:58Z).

rows.decision: Contingency plan for homeless people: Amadora Este, Santa Apolónia, Marquês de Pombal, Moscavide and Interface das Olaias stations open on the nights of 10-11 and 11-12 November
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Read on Metro's own home page banner at 23:33Z (was evidence from a search summary at 22:05Z).

rows.decision: Possible disruption on Wednesday announced by Fertagus, Carris and Carris Metropolitana; no suspension announced (as of 16:59Z)

rows.decision: All national coach services suspended Wednesday 10:00 to 23:59
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Jornal de Negócios live 12:39 (company statement) and Jornal Económico 17:47; earlier text "to midnight" came from a search summary and was wrong.

rows.decision: Ferries start at 05:00 as usual on Wednesday; reassessed from 12:00 (the latter from a search summary)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: From a search summary of press reports; the article itself not yet opened.

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Red wind warning, Lisbon district, 11 Nov 12:00 to 21:00 (gusts to 120, up to 140 km/h)
rows.label: fact

rows.note: IPMA's CAP message 2.49.0.0.620.0.PT.261110071840.PO-01-1915, sent_utc 2026-11-10T07:18:40Z, severity Extreme, onset 11 Nov 12:00, expires 21:00; replaces the wind message sent 2026-11-09T13:27:16Z. rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Red warnings for Madeira's south coast and mountains: rain from 21:00 Tuesday to 06:00 Wednesday; wind gusts to 140 km/h from 00:00
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Lusa via Jornal de Negócios live 00:09 (hours); DNOTICIAS listing headline 10 Nov 07:24, "IPMA coloca costa Sul e zonas montanhosas da Madeira sob aviso vermelho". IPMA's send time not read by us (the meteorologist's CAP file covers Lisbon).

rows.decision: TAP's site alert: "Dias 10 e 11 de novembro - Condições meteorológicas adversas em todo o território português" (criticality medium)
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Read at source 13:15Z in the page's embedded data (alerts[0]: id portugal-meteo-conditions, publishDate 2026-11-10T09:00:00.000Z); the alert body text is not in the page. Offered by incident.transport@ (13:14Z), checked by us. TAP's rebooking offer (tap-adjusts) is press only.

rows.decision: Alert situation for all of mainland Portugal, 11 Nov 00:00 to 23:59: (a) schools and non-essential public services close; (b) outdoor events suspended, whatever their nature; (c) no access to high-risk parks; (d) temporary structures secured; (e) no access to shoreline and flood areas; activates coordination centres and civil-protection commissions
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Announced at about 09:17 (minister, ANEPC press conference); the declaration published at 12:10 on portugal.gov.pt. Before 01:00Z on 11 Nov this edge carried only 12:10 (the page time), which put the announcement 3 h late (question raised by incident.conductor@ from incident.media@'s live entries). In force from 00:00 (Lusa, 00:09). Legal text: Despacho n.º 13773-A/2026 (Diário da República, 2nd series, supplement, 10 Nov), read at source 02:28Z. It names no event: Web Summit is not mentioned; outdoor events are suspended by 2(b).

rows.decision: The Interior Minister: "a Web Summit é um local fechado"; if the organisers decide to keep the event, they may
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador live entry 09:30:25 (JSON-LD), questioned by journalists at the press conference. 8 h 23 min later the government recommended suspending Wednesday (17:53).

rows.decision: Madeira schools closed on Wednesday morning, reopening from 13:00
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Announced at a regional press conference by the president of the regional civil protection service (Observador 12:11:17, JSON-LD); DNOTICIAS headline 11:26 "Escolas da Madeira encerradas na manhã de quarta-feira até às 13 horas" (a search summary attributes it to the regional government). Most critical hours given as 21:00 to 06:00 (IPMA Madeira at the same conference).

rows.decision: Schools closed on Wednesday
rows.label: fact

rows.decision: Three cruise calls at Funchal for Wednesday cancelled (Iona, Le Dumont d'Urville, Vasco da Gama)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: APRAM via Observador live 12:33:37 (JSON-LD). The ships cancelled; APRAM reported it.

rows.decision: Organisers: aware of the warnings, assessing with ANEPC and PSP, update to follow; no sign yet of cancelling Wednesday
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Press report of an organiser statement; not found on websummit.com.

rows.decision: Court presidents may close courts fully or partly on Wednesday; urgent acts must go ahead
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CSM vice-president's despacho, via Lusa (Observador 12:51:24, 14:32:02). National, not Madeira-specific: "Madeira's courts closed" (Wikipedia) NOT established. csm.org.pt answered (01:45Z) with no matching notice on its home page.

rows.by_name: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (mayor, municipal civil protection)
rows.decision: All Lisbon road tunnels closed from midnight; parks, gardens and cultural facilities too (the mayor, after meeting civil protection)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: "at" is the article time. Observed: Observador 00:20:13Z reports the Campo Pequeno, Entrecampos and Marquês de Pombal tunnels (Avenida da República) still open after midnight: the headline says 00:15, the body 00:50 (the entry is inconsistent). The closure as announced vs as observed: not established when they closed.

rows.by_name: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (mayor, municipal civil protection)
rows.decision: Mayor: "Tudo indica que a Web Summit não poderá funcionar amanhã"; the decision is the Interior Ministry's and the organisers'
rows.label: evidence

rows.decision: State museums and monuments closed on Wednesday; tickets can be changed or refunded
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador 14:08:23 quoting MMP's online message. At 19:21 Observador adds Lisbon's 25 municipal cultural venues (EGEAC) closed.

rows.by_name: Lusoponte (25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges)
rows.decision: 25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges limited to 60 km/h
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Not a conflict but a sequence: Lusa at 22:29 reports the restrictions lifted (bridges-lifted).

rows.decision: "Situação meteorológica adversa — Depressão Charles: medidas preventivas"; the page lists the warnings in force by area (e.g. north coast: rain 21:00 Tue to 06:00 Wed, then 06:00 to 09:00; wind 21:00 Tue to 12:00 Wed; sea 09:00 to 21:00 Wed; south coast rain 21:00 to 06:00)
rows.label: fact
rows.note: SRPC's own page, dateCreated 2026-11-10T15:27:01Z (Madeira = UTC in November). No official count of occurrences on it; "14 occurrences in the first hour of red" is DNOTICIAS (press, 22:00).

rows.decision: TAP adjusts operations; passengers with tickets for travel up to 11 Nov may rebook without penalty to flights up to 17 Nov
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador 16:09:04. "TAP cancelling 10 Madeira flights" (Wikipedia) is NOT established: Observador 19:47:28 says only that several TAP Funchal flights were affected on Wednesday, from ANA's site.

rows.decision: Communiqué no. 2: rain, wind and sea agitation, Depressão CHARLES, mainland and Madeira

rows.label: evidence

rows.decision: FlixBus suspends all national links in Portugal on Wednesday 11 Nov
rows.label: evidence

rows.decision: Day 3 (Thursday 12 Nov): "Web Summit aims to proceed with Day 3 (Thursday, November 12) as planned, following the passing of Storm Charles. [...] provide further updates as soon as confirmed information becomes available."
rows.label: fact

Same organiser page as websummit-wednesday; press (Jornal de Negócios 19:42, RTP 19:46) followed. 05:33Z: watched via Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press (Jornal de Negócios live to 00:09): nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 06:33Z: via Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 07:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 08:39Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 09:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 10:32Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 11:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 12:32Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 13:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 14:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 15:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 16:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 17:40Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z Tue) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 18:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z Tue) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 19:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z Tue) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 20:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z Tue) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 21:34Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z Tue) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold). 22:33Z: Bluesky (last post 17:36Z Tue) and the press: nothing new; websummit.com not read (terms hold).

rows.decision: Day 2 (Wednesday 11 Nov) will not take place: "Web Summit will of course respect the Government's direction, and accordingly, Day 2 (Wednesday, November 11th) will not take place." Reasons given: tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport, high winds on external structures; after discussions with the government, ANEPC and PSP.
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Web Summit's own page "Important event update": datePublished 2026-11-10T19:09:00, dateModified 19:25:44 (the page's JSON-LD; Lisbon = UTC). Found first by incident.conductor@ (read 20:58Z); re-read at source by us at 20:59Z. The organisers' email followed at 19:38Z and the press at 19:42Z. We missed the page from 19:09 to 20:58: it is in the blog list (/blog/), not in sitemap.xml, and we watched only the sitemap, the home page and /news/. Lead time: 1 h 16 min after the government's recommendation (17:53), 16 h 51 min before the red warnings start (12:00 Wed). 21:33Z: the blog listing gives Post.modified 20:06:54 (19:58 when incident.dev@ read it); the page's JSON-LD is still 19:25:44 and post.content is unchanged since our 20:59Z read (sha256 e055635213ca, 1060 characters): listing metadata moved, the text did not. "Formally advised": no legal text found for it. The despacho does not name Web Summit; the advice is in the organisers' own words (19:09 page) and the Prime Minister's recommendation (17:53, press).

rows.label: evidence

rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Lusa, quoting a CP statement; Jornal de Negócios live entry 23:10. Not read on cp.pt (JavaScript app).

rows.decision: The Porto Brandão – Trafaria – Pedrouços/Algés ferry suspended on Wednesday (the Algés promenade, where the Pedrouços/Algés terminal is, is closed); alternative: Trafaria – Porto Brandão – Belém
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador 23:59:09Z quoting a Transtejo Soflusa communiqué "divulgado hoje à noite". ttsl.pt (read 06:33Z) shows no notice.

rows.decision: Porto Santo: power cuts and some communication difficulties reported
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 01:02:24Z (no source body named). An impact, not a decision: recorded so the Porto Santo lead has a dated press address. The mayor's measures are still not found at source.

rows.decision: Barreiro's buses run with restrictions: weekday timetable to 12:00 (express 4 and 8 not running); from 12:00 reduced to essential lines (1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 14, 15), about every 30 minutes
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador 01:03:19Z citing a notice on the Câmara Municipal do Barreiro's page; cm-barreiro.pt home (06:33Z) shows no such notice in its text.

rows.decision: Occurrence count, Madeira: 71 since 20:00 Tuesday, as at 02:00 Wednesday (22 floodings, 13 mass movements/landslides, 7 fallen trees; Machico 20, Santa Cruz 18, Câmara de Lobos 10, Funchal 10, Ponta do Sol 4, Calheta 3, Porto Santo 1, Ribeira Brava 1, Santana 1, 3 unassigned; 193 responder deployments, 72 vehicle mobilisations)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: DN Madeira (by Rúben Santos) via SAPO, published 02:10:06Z, modified 02:29:08Z: "segundo a mais recente actualização da plataforma de informação à comunicação social da Protecção Civil Regional, consultada pelas 2h00". The count is SRPC's, but read through its press-information platform, which is not public. SRPC's public site (procivmadeira.pt news list, read 03:51Z) carries no count: its latest items are the measures page (2158, 10 Nov 15:27) and Aviso 17/2026 (2157, created 6 Nov 11:31). Earlier counts in the press: 14 (DNOTICIAS 22:00), 26 to 22:30, 38, 42 (Funchal Notícias). "Fallen trees 7" per the article; the Wikipedia lead matches.

rows.by_name: ANEPC (Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil)
rows.decision: Occurrence count, mainland: 66 at 03:30, none classed significant; 4 floods (Mem Martins, Cacém e São Marcos, Península de Setúbal); 60 responders, 22 vehicles
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 05:44:15Z, citing ANEPC's public portal. prociv.gov.pt/pt/ocorrencias/ answers 200 (137 KB, read 07:33Z) but its data is not in the HTML: parser ask to incident.dev@.

rows.by_name: ANEPC (Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil)
rows.decision: Occurrence count, mainland: 60 to 06:00, mostly floods; Greater Lisbon and the Setúbal Peninsula most affected
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 08:26:01Z, ANEPC's situation briefing. (03:30: 66 per the portal; the two counts are from different windows or methods: not reconciled.)

rows.decision: 16 flights to and from Madeira airport cancelled, mostly this morning (7 arrivals, 9 departures: Lisbon, Porto, Paris, Nantes)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 07:05:50Z, from ANA's site consulted at 06:50 (ANA's site shows us a bot page).

rows.decision: Occurrence count, Madeira: at least 162 so far; 425 responders, 171 means
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 06:50, "segundo os dados disponibilizados" (SRPC's press platform, not public). Earlier: 71 to 02:00, 115 (CNN 06:05).

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: IPMA lowers Lisbon's wind warning from red to orange: Wednesday 09:00 to 21:00, gusts up to 120 km/h ("Rajadas até 120 km/h"); the red rain 09:00 to 18:00 stands
rows.label: fact
rows.note: CAP message sent 2026-11-11T07:16:30Z, severity Severe (orange), onset 09:00, expires 21:00 (incident.meteorologist@'s cap.json, commit 287ae82e). IPMA's open data showed it by 08:40Z (still red at 07:38 per the meteorologist). At 08:40Z red remains in 9 districts for rain (incl. Lisbon) and in Faro for wind. Day 2 had been called off partly for "the impact of high winds on external structures" (organisers, 19:09 Tue): we record the downgrade, not a judgement. 10:02Z (CNN Portugal, from IPMA): Faro is the only district still red for wind; Évora, Setúbal, Santarém, Lisboa, Leiria, Beja and Portalegre lowered to orange. Superseded at 12:33:13Z by ipma-cut-1233.

rows.decision: Access to Funchal's centre closed for safety this morning; the public asked not to go to affected areas nor pass the restrictions
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 07:25:40Z quoting an SRPC communiqué (via Lusa). Not on procivmadeira.pt's news list at 07:33Z (latest item still 2158).

rows.decision: 18 sea bars closed at 07:30 because of the weather; considerable worsening of sea conditions on the mainland until 12:00 Thursday (waves up to about 6 m significant height)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 08:06:40Z quoting a Navy/AMN communiqué. Not yet read on amn.pt; whether the Lisbon bar is among the 18 is not stated.

rows.by_name: Lusoponte (25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges)
rows.decision: Vasco da Gama bridge limited to 100 km/h since 07:30 for reduced visibility; usual limits on the 25 de Abril bridge; Lusoponte advises against motorcycles and high-sided vehicles

rows.note: Lusoponte via CNN Portugal live 10:50:16Z (Lusa). lusoponte.pt still unreachable to us.

rows.decision: Occurrence count, Madeira: 205 to 09:00; 542 responders, 216 vehicles; none classed as serious ("nenhuma das situações foi considerada grave")
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Presented by the regional president at SRPC on Wednesday morning (DNOTICIAS, published 09:30:45Z); CNN Portugal had 205 at 08:59. SRPC's own site carries no count.

rows.by_name: Lisbon airport (ANA, Humberto Delgado) and airlines
rows.decision: 222 flights cancelled at Lisbon and Faro by 09:20 (departures and arrivals): 208 at Lisbon (Humberto Delgado), 14 at Faro
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 09:54:01Z, from ANA's site (ANA's site shows us a bot page). Earlier: "at least 40" (24noticias, Tue).

rows.decision: Regional president's briefing at SRPC: "479 milímetros de precipitação em 12 horas", more than the 387 mm of 20 February 2010 over the same reference period; hourly peak 65 l/m² at 06:00 against 78 in 2010; most critical period 02:00 to 03:00 (heavy rain with high tide and high stream flows)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: DNOTICIAS 09:30:45Z, with his words quoted. Station and 12-hour window are NOT named in the article. incident.meteorologist@'s IPMA figure for Areeiro is 474.7 mm in twelve hourly values to 05:00 (483.6 in thirteen): close, but which station and window he used is not established. One outlet gives 237 mm for 2010 (search summary, not opened); DNOTICIAS says 387.

rows.by_name: Regimento de Sapadores Bombeiros (Lisbon fire brigade)
rows.decision: Occurrence count, Lisbon city: about 50 from 00:00 to 10:00, mostly floods
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: RSB source to Lusa, via CNN Portugal live 11:26:00Z.

rows.decision: Carris (its own page): service continues, priority to essential journeys (health, emergency workers); Web Summit shuttle lines cancelled "devido à suspensão do evento"; Graça funicular closed since 10:40; trams 15E, 25E, 24E, 28E, 12E, 18E interrupted in sequence, 15E replaced by buses on the same route; bus 763 diverted at Carnide cemetery (5 stops dropped); Saldanha and Cais do Sodré sales points closed
rows.label: fact

rows.decision: The Interior Minister: the alert situation ends at midnight as planned; the government expects the country to return to normal on Thursday, with repair work; the government's crisis centre (CorGov, coordinated by the Prime Minister) meets after the Council of Ministers; "o período mais grave está aí à porta" (warning of heavy rain coinciding with high tide; the Algarve the main concern)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CNN Portugal live 14:44:00Z (to journalists after the Council of Ministers at São Bento, from 09:30). Consistent with the despacho's period (to 23:59 on 11 Nov). An expectation, not a decision about Thursday's services. Same press appearance (to journalists at the end of the Council of Ministers at São Bento): CNN Portugal entries 14:44 (alert ends at midnight), 15:17 ("O período mais grave está aí à porta"), 15:21 (no "excesso de zelo"). So the words were said by 15:17 at the latest, before IPMA's 15:55:03 CAP message that ended Lisbon's orange wind, and after IPMA's 12:33 cut (Lisbon red rain to 15:00). The exact minute is not established. No government page or transcript with a time found: portugal.gov.pt's news list (read 16:43Z) shows no item for it. DN 16:03, Público 16:05 and RTP 16:30 carried the quote later.

rows.label: evidence
